text.tspan: VLSM cuts one block unevenly · summarisation announces many blocks as one
Each start is where the previous one ended, and always
a valid boundary for the smaller size.
A router in London carries 1 route
instead of 4 for the subnets in Pune
only if the first starts on a multiple of 2^k
